meta.title: 调色再好也没用！高手差距藏在人像液化里
meta.title_en: Great Color Can't Save a Photo — the Gap Is in the Liquify
meta.topic: 修图 · 液化 · 人像

scenes.title_cn: 一个观点：高手差距在液化不在调色
scenes.title_en: The Claim: Pros Differ in Liquify, Not Color
scenes.context: 很多粉丝问调色参数，但作者点破：真正决定一张人像高级与否的，是液化不是调色。调色能改氛围，液化才改骨相。
sentences: 很多粉丝问我调色参数，但我先说结论。
A lot of followers ask for my color settings, but let me give the punchline first.
punchline（结论/点睛）
高手和普通人的差距，藏在液化里。
The gap between pros and amateurs hides in the liquify.
liquify（液化）
调色改的是氛围，液化改的是骨相。
Color changes the mood; liquify changes the bone structure.
bone structure（骨相）
paraphrase: Let me skip to the takeaway before the how-to.
One reshapes the light, the other reshapes the face.
scenes.speak: A lot of followers ask for my color settings, but let me give the punchline first. The gap between pros and amateurs hides in the liquify. Color changes the mood; liquify changes the bone structure.

scenes.title_cn: 液化的节奏：先大骨架后小细节
scenes.title_en: The Liquify Rhythm: Big Structure First, Details After
scenes.context: 高手液化有固定顺序：先把整体轮廓、五官比例拉对，再回头处理下颌线、颧骨这类小细节。顺序反了，细节越修越歪。
sentences: 先处理大骨架，再碰小细节。
Fix the big structure first, then touch the small details.
big structure（大骨架）
下颌线和颧骨，是后面的细活。
The jawline and cheekbones are the fine work that comes later.
jawline（下颌线）
顺序反了，越修越歪。
Reverse the order and every fix makes it worse.
reverse the order（颠倒顺序）
paraphrase: Set the frame right before you refine the finish.
Details can't save a wrong proportion.
scenes.speak: Fix the big structure first, then touch the small details. The jawline and cheekbones are the fine work that comes later. Reverse the order and every fix makes it worse.

scenes.title_cn: 留痕是原罪：稳、匀、不夸张
scenes.title_en: Tell-Tale Signs Are the Sin: Steady, Even, Restrained
scenes.context: 液化最容易露馅的是痕迹：皮肤拉扯纹、五官比例突然失衡。高手的原则是稳、匀、不夸张——改到刚好看不出来为止，而不是改到极致。
sentences: 液化最怕的是留下拉扯的痕迹。
The worst outcome in liquify is leaving stretching marks.
stretching marks（拉扯痕迹）
高手的原则是稳、匀、不夸张。
The pro's rule is steady, even, and restrained.
restrained（克制的）
改到刚好看不出来，才是最好的。
The best edit is the one you can't quite see.
can't quite see（看不出来）
paraphrase: If it looks untouched, you did it right.
Leave it before you overdo it.
scenes.speak: The worst outcome in liquify is leaving stretching marks. The pro's rule is steady, even, and restrained. The best edit is the one you can't quite see.

practice: The pro gap is in the liquify.
「改到看不出来」用英文怎么说？
The best edit is the one you can't see.
The rule in liquify is restraint.
pitfalls: Start fine-tuning details before the structure is right.
Lock the big proportions first, then details.
Details can't fix a wrong base.
Push the liquify to the extreme for a 'perfect' face.
Overdone liquify leaves tell-tale stretching and looks fake.
Chase color presets while the face is still off.
Fix structure before you set the mood.
Color can't rescue a shape that's wrong.
Compare your work zoomed in only.
Check the face at full view, then zoom.
Zoomed-in edits can wreck the whole-face balance.
shifts: 意识到骨相修正是差距所在
理解改到看不出来才是高级
